The vendor and service logos NetRollout shows, as their sources served them
on 2026-11-02 (sha256 in ../SHA256SUMS). The brands are their owners'
trademarks, shown only to name a device's platform or a service.

Simple Icons 16.36.0 (CC0 1.0 - simple-icons-LICENSE.md; read
simple-icons-DISCLAIMER.md on trademarks), from cdn.simpleicons.org, which
fills each icon with the brand's colour (or the colour asked for); the paths
are those of the npm package simple-icons@16.36.0:
  cisco.svg, junipernetworks.svg, fortinet.svg, paloaltonetworks.svg, hp.svg,
  grafana.svg, postgresql-336791.svg (postgresql in #336791)
